subject.title: fix(clawrouter): guard usage snapshot fetch against SSRF redirects

question: Should ClawRouter usage adopt the established trusted environment-proxy SSRF mode, where OpenClaw validates each redirect hostname locally but the operator-configured proxy resolves destination DNS?
rationale: The implementation correctly applies the repository's shared mechanism, but accepting the residual trust in an operator-configured proxy requires human security intent.

options.title: Accept the established boundary
options.body: Approve this head because every redirect hostname is checked before proxy dispatch while existing proxy-dependent setups remain supported.

options.title: Require direct pinned DNS
options.body: Request direct-only transport and explicitly accept breaking usage requests for operators who require HTTP(S)_PROXY.

recommendation.title: Accept the established boundary
recommendation.body: Approve this head because every redirect hostname is checked before proxy dispatch while existing proxy-dependent setups remain supported.
